name: Unbreathing Horde
oracle_text:
This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other Zombie you control and each Zombie card in your graveyard.
If this creature would be dealt damage, prevent that damage and remove a +1/+1 counter from it.
blocked_sentences: This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each other Zombie you control and each Zombie card in your graveyard.

needs.what: a verification-sandbox prop for a 0/0 whose enters-with counters count its own creature subtype: a Zombie among your board creatures or sandbox graveyard cards (a quiet one, chosen only for a card that needs it, the way verify.swap_in_tribal_body serves a tribal tap cost), so the card enters with at least one counter and survives gate 4. Both lines are expressible: the enters line as self_enters_with_counters with a sum of two counts, the damage line as prevent_damage prevent_all with remove_counters {counter: +1/+1, amount: 1}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The sandbox's own creatures (the alphabetically first creature, an Ooze) and graveyard props (small_creature, flier) are no Zombies, so the exactly-written card enters as a 0/0 with no counters and dies to state-based actions; gate 4 rejects it as 'a permanent but ended in graveyard'. swap_in_tribal_body is keyed only to an additional cost that taps a subtype, not to a count an enters-with replacement reads
